title: Other remote viewing teams trained by Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle

tellings.quote: rumors about the fact that there was other teams of remote viewers being trained by uh by Pat Price and Joe McGonagal other than than put off.

plain: Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe distant places or objects using only the mind, and the US government funded research into it from the 1970s to the 1990s. A host named Jack, on Jesse Michels's show, mentions rumours that two well-known remote viewers, Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle, trained other secret teams of remote viewers besides the one run by the physicist Hal Puthoff. If true, the government's psychic work would have been larger than the known programme.
